findings_and_reconnections.trace: Npy supports i64 payload words and preserves each i64 in NpyIntegerValues. CorrectiveHiddenIndex and CorrectiveFeatureIndex then cast i64 to usize before membership. On a 32-bit target, a value of -4294967296 or +4294967296 narrows to 0; a nonempty admitted hidden/feature extent then accepts coordinate 0. For three joints, checked layout sizes are 24 hidden and 6 features, so zero is in bounds. The borrowed layout prevents ordinary out-of-bounds after this conversion but cannot recover discarded high bits.
findings_and_reconnections.limits: Only language-level integer reasoning: no NPY file/archive/fixture, wasm execution, native buffer, or tensor operation created or run. This is a 32-bit target condition; on a 64-bit target these two values do not become zero. Float-to-integer policy and historical cast diagnostics are separate decisions.
findings_and_reconnections.future_repair: Check signedness and representability before conversion to the target-native coordinate and validate against the actual layout, preserving meaningful typed coordinate errors; assess whether external format permits any float-to-integer conversion.

findings_and_reconnections.trace: MhrOutput documents unit normals. vertex_normals computes an area-weighted cross-product sum then floors its length to 1e-12 before division. For one nondegenerate right triangle whose exactly representable f32 centimetre edges have length 2^-30, cross magnitude is 2^-60 and its square 2^-120 is representable; source formula yields a normal of magnitude about 8.67e-7 rather than 1.
findings_and_reconnections.limits: Symbolic floating-point calculation only, no geometry, asset, product output, GPU or backend was executed. It requires extremely small admitted geometry and a nonzero accumulated normal; genuinely unreferenced or degenerate zero normals are a distinct intentional case. Backend numeric modes are not certified.
findings_and_reconnections.future_repair: Use a defined scale-aware normalization that preserves valid nonzero directions and intentional zero for truly absent/degenerate geometry; document/justify numerical limits without imposing arbitrary minimum physical size.
